properties.displayName: UAV S36 - Mission Plan Self-Approval (2-Person Control Bypass)
properties.description: 임무계획 2인통제 우회 탐지. [A] Planner == Approver(자기승인) [B] Approver가 Approved_MPS_Planner_List상 ApproverAuthority=true가 아닌 자(승인권한 없는 자의 승인) 탐지. MITRE: T1204, T1078
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let PlannerAuth =
    _GetWatchlist('Approved_MPS_Planner_List')
    | project OperatorId, ApproverAuthority;
let Created = UAVMissionPlan_CL
    | where EventType == "plan_created"
    | project PlanId, Planner, UAVId, Roe, CreatedTime = TimeGenerated;
let Approved = UAVMissionPlan_CL
    | where EventType == "plan_approved" and TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | project PlanId, Approver, ApprovedTime = TimeGenerated;
Approved
| join kind=inner (Created) on PlanId
| join kind=leftouter (PlannerAuth) on $left.Approver == $right.OperatorId
| extend approverHasAuthority = isnotnull(ApproverAuthority) and tobool(ApproverAuthority) == true
| extend isSelfApproval = (Planner == Approver)
| extend isUnauthorizedApprover = not(approverHasAuthority)
| where isSelfApproval or isUnauthorizedApprover
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    isSelfApproval, strcat("임무계획_2인통제_자기승인_", Planner),
    strcat("임무계획_승인권한없는_Approver_", Approver))
| extend Severity = "High"
| project TimeGenerated = ApprovedTime, PlanId, Planner, Approver, UAVId, Roe, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S36 - Mission Plan Self-Approval (2-Person Control Bypass) - {{Planner}}
